mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in less than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates a broad-based economic slowdown, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in INDPRO and HOUST fails to predict negative returns in more than 30% of cases (i.e., 20-day returns are positive in >30% of instances).

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising above 2.0% for 3 consecutive months), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns due to higher discount rates and reduced liquidity, over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances during the tightening cycle, or the Rank IC is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in consumer spending (measured by RSAFS) above its 12-month moving average compresses the equity risk premium, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The positive correlation between RSAFS and SPX 20-day returns breaks down (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1000 thousand units, it signals a contraction in the housing sector that reduces GDP growth and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when HOUST < 1000.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) combined with a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a dual shock to the economy, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The negative return prediction fails in more than 35% of instances where both UNRATE and FEDFUNDS are rising (i.e., 20-day returns are positive in >35% of such cases).

mechanism_narrative: During a supply-side contraction (INDPRO falling below 95 for 2 consecutive months), manufacturing output declines, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances during the supply contraction period.
